verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a dedicated LLM-judge metric type that scores calls against natural-language criteria, plus custom rubrics for defining success criteria. Metric evaluation runs automatically on ingested calls and can be sampled to cut costs, so configurable LLM-as-a-judge scoring is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: detail on judge configuration (model choice, scoring scales or output types), and independent or hands-on corroboration of judge quality.
